title: Detecting Knowledge Inconsistencies Across Text, Tables, and Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2607.25959v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Wikipedia and Wikidata are widely used for information access, LLM pre-training, and retrieval-augmented generation. Their knowledge is deeply connected but scattered across text, tables, and knowledge graphs. This raises a practical question: when these modalities disagree, how can we detect and explain the conflict? We study this problem as modality-level inconsistency detection. We first introduce a taxonomy of cross-modal knowledge inconsistencies, covering information granularity differences, direct conflicts, temporal changes, and KG incompleteness. We then present Kontrast, an automatic framework that uses Text-to-SPARQL and LLM reasoning to compare table-based answers with KG evidence and categorize the resulting inconsistencies. translated_title: 检测文本、表格与知识图谱之间的知识不一致性
translated_abstract: 维基百科和维基数据被广泛用于信息获取、大语言模型预训练以及检索增强生成。它们的知识紧密关联，却分散在文本、表格和知识图谱之中。这引出了一个实际问题：当这些模态之间存在分歧时，我们如何检测并解释这种冲突？我们将该问题作为模态级不一致性检测来研究。我们首先提出了一个跨模态知识不一致性的分类体系，涵盖信息粒度差异、直接冲突、时间变化和知识图谱不完整性。随后我们提出了Kontrast——一个自动框架，它利用Text-to-SPARQL和大语言模型推理，将基于表格的答案与知识图谱证据进行比较，并对由此产生的不一致性进行分类。在多种表格问答数据集上的实验表明，跨模态不一致性普遍存在且蕴含丰富信息。它们不仅揭示了真实的知识冲突，还揭示了知识图谱结构的缺失以及时间性的不匹配。
tldr: 提出了跨模态知识不一致性的分类体系，并构建了自动检测框架Kontrast，通过Text-to-SPARQL与大语言模型推理来对比表格答案与知识图谱证据，从而检测并分类二者之间的知识冲突。
en_tdlr: Proposes a taxonomy of cross-modal knowledge inconsistencies and Kontrast, an automatic framework that leverages Text-to-SPARQL and LLM reasoning to compare table-based answers against knowledge graph evidence, detecting and categorizing knowledge conflicts.
